business: Baghdad Express (بغداد إكسبريس): a buy-for-me and shipping service from Chinese sites (Taobao, 1688, Pinduoduo) to Baghdad
target: Baghdad residents, 18 to 45, who already shop online on Instagram, Shein-type apps or through agents, and want items from China that are not sold in Iraq or are cheaper there. Incomes are shown in US dollars per year (converted from monthly IQD at an assumed 1 USD = 1,450 IQD); the buyer lives and pays in IQD.

segments.name: Young woman shopping for fashion, beauty and home items
Young man buying electronics, accessories and car parts
Parent buying kids' items and household goods
Small shop owner who resells goods (clothes, accessories, phone accessories)

behaviours.name: Instagram agent buyer
behaviours.how: Already orders through Instagram/WhatsApp pages that buy from Shein or China for them, pays a deposit, waits weeks.

behaviours.name: Cash on delivery only
behaviours.how: Refuses to pay anything before the item is in their hands; has heard of people losing money to online pages.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Compares prices between pages and the local market, will switch for a few thousand dinars.

behaviours.name: Loyal to an existing service
behaviours.how: Uses an established app or company (e.g. one based in Erbil) and has had mostly good experiences.

behaviours.name: Watches TikTok reviews first
behaviours.how: Only buys after seeing unboxing videos or a friend's recommendation.

behaviours.name: Bulk buyer for a shop
behaviours.how: Buys in quantity to resell; cares about landed cost per piece, reliability and delivery dates.

behaviours.name: Urgent need
behaviours.how: Needs a specific item (a part, a gift) that is not available in Baghdad and wants it as fast as possible.

objections: Will extra fees appear when the parcel arrives in Iraq?
I don't trust paying in advance to a new name I've never heard of
It will take too long, I've waited weeks before
What if the item is wrong, fake or damaged? Can I return it?
The page I already use is cheaper or I'm used to it
Shipping per kilo makes small cheap items not worth it
I can find something similar in the Baghdad market today
habits: you scroll Instagram and TikTok every evening and save product posts
you pay with Zain Cash or cash, you don't have a foreign card
you live in a Baghdad district where delivery drivers sometimes struggle to find the address
your cousin once lost a deposit to an online page that disappeared
you visit Shorja or Karrada markets to compare prices
you order from a page on Instagram about once a month
